title: TopologyArtifactOverlayCompileTarget
description: Target hint for compiling a topology artifact follow-up into overlay operations.

text.description: Natural-language target text after the agent has identified this as a topology artifact follow-up, for example 'Dist1', 'the root bridge', or 'alternate ports'.

nodeIds.description: Explicit topology node ids from UI artifact context or prior tool resolution.

edgeIds.description: Explicit topology edge ids from UI artifact context or prior tool resolution.

layerIds.description: Existing overlay layer ids to remove, replace, or inspect.

targetScope.description: Prior topology result scope to target for chained relationship follow-ups.
